scientific_integrity.domain: Stationary geometric NonLINAR(1), with strictly positive finite thinning and marginal means.
scientific_integrity.limitations: Not established for degenerate parameter endpoints, other count marginals, or nonstationary chains; no claim of global common shock across time.
scientific_integrity.priority_limitations: Older discrete minification and reversibility literature available only as abstracts; priority remains qualified.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Exact generating-function algebra, all-index Gram determinant, geometric off-diagonal ratios, monotone coupling.
scientific_integrity.verification_limitations: Finite checker tests identities and samples; the infinite claim rests on analytic proof. No independent mathematical validation.

title: Reversibility and a three-band minor sign law for geometric-minification count chains
